scams.name: Full Moon Party Drug Stings & Police Cash Extortion
scams.description: The Full Moon Party at Haad Rin draws 30,000+ tourists per month to Koh Phangan's southern tip. On the periphery, undercover police run drug stings: you buy mushroom shakes or cannabis from a beach seller, then are stopped by officers who produce the same substance from your pocket and demand ฿30,000–฿100,000 cash 'or jail.' Travelers describe the surge: 'There has been a really big surge in raids at popular Thai pubs over the past few months.' Koh Phangan specifically saw arrests of Israeli soldiers on drug charges in October 2025 (Bangkok Post 'Israelis arrested at drug party on Koh Phangan' / Khaosod English 'Israeli Soldiers Face Drug Charges After Noisy Cease-Fire Party on Koh Phangan', 2025-10-14).
scams.avoidance: Do not buy, carry, or consume any recreational drug on Koh Phangan — Thai law is unforgiving and enforcement is active If stopped, refuse to pay cash on the spot and insist on going to the nearest real police station with receipt processing Avoid beach areas away from the Haad Rin main Full Moon strip at night — stings happen on the outskirts Cannabis requires medical prescription in Thailand post-2025; street cannabis is illegal and sellers are marked Save Tourist Police 1155 before going out — they handle tourists more humanely than general police
scams.location: Haad Rin beach (Full Moon Party), Baan Tai, Thong Sala pier area

scams.name: Haad Rin Scooter Passport-Hostage Damage
scams.description: You rent a 125cc scooter on Haad Rin for ฿250 a day. The shop takes your passport. After 3 days of riding you return it and the owner points at a scratch on the underside of the fairing you're certain wasn't there — ฿11,000 repair quote, passport in their drawer. One traveler wrote: 'Me and two friends are currently on Ko Pha Ngan and rented a scooter each from a shop… each scratched part would have to be fully replaced at 2,000+ each regardless of how…' Three friends, same day, were hit for ฿11,000–฿13,000 each.
scams.avoidance: Never leave your original passport — offer ฿5,000–฿10,000 cash deposit plus photocopy, walk away from shops that refuse Rent in Thong Sala (main town) rather than Haad Rin beach strip — longer-term shops have reputation constraints Photograph every panel including underside with timestamps; email to yourself for cloud backup Read shop's Google and Reddit reviews before committing — scam shops are flagged quickly If passport is held and fake damage charged, call Tourist Police 1155 — Phangan enforcement has responded since the 2025 Russian rental bust
scams.location: Haad Rin rental shops, Thong Sala town, Baan Tai, Srithanu

scams.name: Cannabis Dispensary Overpricing & Fake-Strength Flower
scams.description: You walk into a Thong Sala cannabis dispensary on Koh Phangan and see a menu listing 'OG Kush 70% THC — ฿3,000/gram.' Travelers cut through it: 'Hahaha 70% THC? :D sorry but this is a scam. The biological theoretical maximum is at 34%.' The same flower costs ฿500–฿800/gram at legitimate Bangkok or Chiang Mai dispensaries, and the 70% THC claim is physically impossible. Phangan dispensaries routinely 3–5x the mainland price on cannabis flower and market obvious low-quality product as 'premium imported.'
scams.avoidance: If you want cannabis in Thailand, buy in Bangkok (Highland Café, Taratera) where price transparency is enforced by competition On Phangan, assume 3–5x markup and do not trust 70%+ THC claims — they are fabricated Avoid edibles entirely — 99% are fraudulent per community consensus and lab tests Never consume cannabis publicly on Phangan — ฿25,000 per-person fines are active Do not buy from beach sellers — these are tied to police-sting extortion operations
scams.location: Thong Sala dispensaries, Haad Rin main strip, Srithanu wellness area

scams.name: Thong Sala Pier Taxi/Songthaew Price Gouging
scams.description: You arrive at Thong Sala Pier off the Lomprayah ferry from Samui. A fleet of songthaews waits. Driver quotes ฿300 per person to Haad Rin (20 km). Locals pay ฿100 shared, ฿150 maximum. Travelers give the community baseline: 'Their are tons of tuk tuks.. they will try to overcharge you, negotiate every time.' The Phangan songthaew scam is pier-specific — drivers camped at the ferry pier quote tourist rates, while drivers flagged down on the main road give local rates.
scams.avoidance: Walk 200m inland from Thong Sala Pier before accepting any ride — pier-parked drivers always quote tourist rates Know benchmark rates: Thong Sala → Haad Rin ฿150 per person shared, ฿400 private; Thong Sala → Srithanu ฿100 per person Pre-book hotel airport/pier pickup via your accommodation — fixed price in writing During Full Moon Party, accept prices will be 2–3x; budget accordingly, travel in groups to split cost Use Grab/Bolt opportunistically but have a backup songthaew plan — coverage is patchy
scams.location: Thong Sala Ferry Pier, Haad Rin road, cross-island Srithanu–Haad Rin route

scams.name: Haad Rin Accommodation ‘Last-Minute Cancellation’ Fraud
scams.description: Your Haad Rin bungalow host messages you 4 days before Full Moon check-in: 'Water pipe broken, must cancel your booking, but I have another place — please cancel on Airbnb and pay me ฿8,000 cash directly.' This is a standard off-platform scam — the host wants you to cancel (they keep your prepayment minus the cancellation fee) and pay them cash for a non-existent 'replacement' unit. Community reports document an identical pattern on Phi Phi, directly transferable to Phangan. One traveler wrote: 'was able to cancel everything with full refund. I would have had to pay the entire fee for the AirBnB if they hadn't made me cancel…'
scams.avoidance: Book only via Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb, or Hostelworld with credit-card payment — never wire cash Never cancel your booking on the host's request — make them cancel (they incur the penalty) Contact platform support immediately when anything feels off; document all messages Screenshot your booking confirmation, address, and platform protection terms before arrival For Full Moon Party, book 6+ weeks ahead through a major platform — last-minute bookings are scam-prone and expensive
scams.location: Haad Rin bungalows, Baan Tai hostels, short-term Phangan Airbnbs
